# Expression study (`expression-study` v1)

A differential-expression (RNA-seq) comparison: fold changes and adjusted p-values.

**Group:** Genomics and biology · **Mnemonic:** `EXPR` · **Identifiers:** `EXPR-…` in `studyId`

Open one with `EXPR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: expression-study
version: 1
description: "A differential-expression (RNA-seq) comparison: fold changes and adjusted p-values."
match: { kind: expression-study, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Genomics and biology · Expression study, id: $.studyId }
strip:
  - { label: Study, bind: $.title }
  - { label: Comparison, bind: $.comparison }
  - { label: Samples, bind: $.sampleCount, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Significant genes, bind: $.significant, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: foldChange
    kind: hbar
    title: log2 fold change
    key: F2
    rows: $.results
    label: gene
    value: log2fc
    fmt: price2
    tone: sign
  - id: results
    kind: table
    title: Results
    key: F3
    rows: $.results
    columns:
      - { label: Gene, bind: "@.gene" }
      - { label: log2 FC, bind: "@.log2fc", fmt: signed2, tone: sign, total: true }
      - { label: Mean expression, bind: "@.baseMean", fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Adjusted p, bind: "@.padj" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Header fields

| Label | Bound to | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Study | `$.title` | text |
| Comparison | `$.comparison` | text |
| Samples | `$.sampleCount` | `amount0` |
| Significant genes | `$.significant` | `amount0` |

| Panel | Kind | Rows |
|---|---|---|
| log2 fold change | hbar | `$.results` |
| Results | table | `$.results` |
